title: fix(media): detach lazy background scheduler root
body:
## Summary

- schedule generated-media completion from a context-free async root initialized with the shared work-scope carrier
- explicitly clear AsyncWorkScope ownership before creating the detached microtask
- preserve Matrix monitor-task isolation while preventing lazy scheduler loading from making a requester wait on its own completion handoff
- cover both async-context contracts while proving ordinary owned work remains cancellable

## Validation

- 29 focused media scheduler and completion tests pass on head b93c85542a659b6195efc969853823d4d549e416
- full pnpm check:changed passes on the same head
- lint:plugins:no-extension-test-core-imports passes after rebasing past the unrelated Slack base violation
- both request-local AsyncLocalStorage and AsyncWorkScope are absent in detached work
- live Matrix generated-image scenario passed on revision 568462703eadcc79d99dbd62d40172c81eced7a2 with a real m.image attachment and clean suite exit
